svg.title: Downshift package architecture
svg.desc: cmd/downshift wires five harness adapters (claudecode, cursor, codex, antigravity, kirocrew), the catalog and telemetry. Adapters, catalog and telemetry import core; core imports none of them. internal/paths holds the state directory. routingv2, outcome, benchmark, decisionintelligence and models are offline or opt-in.
svg.text: Arrows mean "imports" and point toward core. Dashed: cmd wires catalog and telemetry directly.
CLI, hook runners, try, models, stats, benchmark
wire format in, wire format out. No routing rules.
core imports no catalog, adapter or telemetry package
state dir ~/.downshift, with fallback to legacy ~/.harness-downshift (used by core, catalog, telemetry, models)
Offline and opt-in. Run from cmd/downshift subcommands, not on the hook path.
